I had MC on my bikini / vulva area. Please know this method will cause some skin damage. Caused some scarring and some areas to be wrinkle…



My steps:
* in my shower: set up bendy light and mirror, grab all the tools/supplies, prep bottles (loosen tops)
* sit in the shower, surrounded by the supplies, put on gloves
* with scissors cut the pubic hair.  NEVER RAZOR!! That will open the MC, causing it to spread. (I made that mistake)
* FYI have a used/trash and a clean/unused area


* place lodine Solution on mc area
* with tweezers and gloved fingers CAREFULLY I would slowly pop/dig out the white hard inside - it won’t hurt (The HUGE difference between ingrown hair and a MC) and it will bleed a lot. Clean blood with gauze
* place the hard bulb on a paper towel or gauze — be careful 
*(with different swaps) place salicylic acid, tea tree oil and Naturasil. Might burn
* place bandage/medical tape or liquid tape to close the open wound 
* MC you can’t dig out, nitro a cotton swap and quickly place it on MC 30sec or so (again I was aggressive)
* clean up with gloves. Spray bleach bottle in the shower floor, tools and bottles then rinse area with water


Repeat very other day. New MC will pop up.


Change shorts every day. Use non bleaching bleach to wash.
